inputs.title: Real-Time Seismic Fault Line Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks
inputs.technical_problem: Manual seismic fault interpretation is slow and susceptible to acoustic noise artifacts
inputs.technical_solution: A deep convolutional network trained on synthetic acoustic impedance volumes
inputs.technical_effect: Accelerates structural boundary demarcation while filtering acoustic reverberations

inputs.title: High-Torque Planetary Gearbox with Torsional Vibration Damping
inputs.technical_problem: Torsional resonance at critical rotational speeds causes premature gear tooth wear
inputs.technical_solution: Resilient elastomer bushings integrated into the planet carrier mounting pins
inputs.technical_effect: Attenuates harmonic vibration peaks across operating frequency spectrum

inputs.title: Ultra-Low-Noise Differential Amplifier with Capacitive Feedback
inputs.technical_problem: Flicker noise in input differential pairs degrades signal-to-noise ratio at audio frequencies
inputs.technical_solution: Chopper-stabilized topology coupled with correlated double sampling capacitive network
inputs.technical_effect: Suppresses 1/f noise while maintaining sub-milliwatt power consumption

inputs.title: High-Temperature Resistant Polyamide Polymer Composition
inputs.technical_problem: Thermal degradation and loss of tensile modulus above 200 degrees Celsius
inputs.technical_solution: A blend of 45-65 wt% semi-aromatic polyamide, 20-35 wt% glass fibers, and 0.5-2 wt% organosilane crosslinker
inputs.technical_effect: Retains over 80% tensile strength after 1000 hours at 220 degrees Celsius
